item.title: Quantra - A Superscalar CPU in Turing Complete
item.description: Quantra is a 16-bit CPU that I built in the logic simulator Turing Complete. It is based on the Allegro architecture that the in-game levels teach you, but is heavily modified from this baseline.

item.title: Documentation of Professor348.github.io
item.description: This post’s purpose is to document this website, as a sort of reference for me to look back on, and for other people to gain inspiration from in their own projects. In it, you will find links to all the resources and softwares that I used to build and host this site. In addition, you will find some of the external learning resources that I used throughout the development of this site.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hi, I’m DanTheCoder, also known as DanTheGamer and Daniel!
I live in the USA and am currently doing dual enrollment online with Liberty University.

Hobbies

I enjoy a wide variety of activities, including but not limited to:

  • Reading (Mainly fiction books)
  • Programming (Codingame.com, Khan Academy)
  • Electronics (Arduinos, Digital logic simulators, etc.)
  • PC Building (Only theoretical at this point)
  • Solving Rubik’s Cubes
  • Gaming (Modded Minecraft, Trailmakers, World of Tanks)
